sections.en: 2 the codex has τὸ αὐτὸ ἐνιαυτὸ ('the same year'). 4 Or Διόσκοροι ἐγεννήθησαν ('the Dioscuri were born')? 4-5 Cf. 34, 26 s. 5 the codex has ποιὴν ('making'). 10 ἐνιαυτοὺς ο' ('70 years') the codex has, ἐ. β' ('2 years') we have corrected to. 12 the codex has ὕπνοι καὶ θάνατοι ('sleeps and deaths'). the codex has σόδωμα καὶ γόμωρρα ('Sodom and Gomorrah'). 14 ἐπιχειρήσεις ('you will attempt') the codex has, ἐπιχειρήσῃς ('you might attempt') we have written. 15-19 Cf. 33, 29 ss. 19 Cf. 37, 4. 23 διάχυνε ('scatter') the codex has, διαχῦναι ('to scatter') we have written. Cf. above 34, 28 and below 37, 26. 25 σωρευθήσεται ('will be heaped up') the codex has, εὑρεθήσεται ('will be found') we have written (and thus elsewhere). 27 εὕρῃ ('might find') the codex has, ἴδῃ ('might see') we have written (and thus elsewhere). 30 Μῶσης ('Moses'). Or Μοῦσαι ('Muses')? (Cumont). 32 the codex has πλωὸς ('of a voyage').

summary.headline: Daily Omens and Auspicious Activities
summary.text: Daily omen readings describe births of biblical and mythic figures and the resulting auspicious or dangerous activities, health, character, dreams, travel, commerce, agriculture, marriage, and lost persons. Entries name Dioscorus, Nahor, Sleep, Death, Sodom and Gomorrah, Truth, Isaac, Moses, and Jacob.
